U.S. Colleges Expect Intl
Enrollment to Fall (2026-27)

New Endowment Tax Rate
for Wealthiest Universities

keyDates.text: Common App 2025-26 first-year application closes at 5 p.m. ET. New 2026-27 cycle opens August 1.
Common App 2026-27 cycle officially opens. Supplemental essay prompts go live for all member schools including all Ivies.
Section 117 foreign gift and contract reporting deadline. ED is scrutinizing foreign financial relationships under new executive order.
Select STATS/Earnings Accountability rule provisions become effective, including new Direct Loan program definitions.
Clery Act annual reporting deadline, which for the first time must include hazing statistics under the Stop Campus Hazing Act.
Typical Early Decision/Early Action deadlines open for Class of 2031. First full cycle under restored test-required policies at Brown, Harvard, Yale, Dartmouth, and others.
ED will release first Earnings Premium metric calculations under STATS rule, using 2021 award year completers' 2025 earnings data.
Most STATS/Earnings Accountability rule provisions become fully effective. Programs failing earnings benchmarks begin losing Direct Loan eligibility.

charts.title: U.S. Colleges' Outlook on International Enrollment: 2026-27
charts.linkText: Read the full IIE Snapshot coverage
charts.footnote: Survey of 585 U.S. colleges and universities hosting 48% of all international students in the U.S. Among institutions expecting decline, 92% cite visa barriers, 80% cite travel restrictions, 77% cite students choosing other countries.

charts.title: Institutions Reporting Fewer International Applications (2026-27 Cycle)
charts.linkText: Read the full IIE Snapshot coverage
charts.footnote: Data from IIE Spring 2026 Snapshot. Declines were especially pronounced at the graduate level (65% of institutions) compared to undergraduate level (60%).

charts.title: Endowment Tax Impact: Annual Cost Estimates for Select Universities
charts.footnote: Yale figure is estimated annual endowment tax cost ($300M). MIT figure represents combined endowment tax plus federal research funding cut exposure ($300M). Princeton figure represents projected 10-year endowment earnings loss ($11B), shown here as average annual ($1.1B). Stanford layoffs (363 positions) and budget cut ($140M) reflect announced operating reductions rather than direct tax cost.
